scope: Test literature-derived relative heading/goal phase structure in modeled PFL3 state without behavior inputs.

mapping.nine_column_note: Sensitivity mapping only. Do not promote MaleCNS C1-C9 to proven preferred goal angles.

readout.left_group: frozen PFL3 turn_drive_left body IDs from steering structure authority
readout.right_group: frozen PFL3 turn_drive_right body IDs from steering structure authority
readout.instance_lr_rule: PFL3 instance R/L is PB metadata only and must not define steering side.

mandatory_reports: frozen left/right structural readout body IDs
forbidden: Do not select threshold from output amplitude.
Do not tune phase offset from DNa02 output or navigation.
Do not use PFL3 instance R/L as steering side.
Do not promote the nine-column mapping because it looks cleaner.
Do not add signed Delta7 dynamics without separate evidence.
next_gate: E002e may connect a passed frozen comparison readout to E002a steering only after E002d-v2 qualification.
claim_boundary: A pass would support a modeled relative-phase PFL3 comparison pattern under explicit literature mapping assumptions, not absolute preferred angles, physiological firing, steering behavior, source finding, or intact-versus-rewire superiority.
